title: Incident retro and safety automation playbook for failed model rollout
creator: Maya Chen
description: Short summary: During a 5% canary rollout of model v3.2.0 -> v3.2.1 (text-generation-13B), we observed elevated token error rates and latency spikes causing automated traffic fallback to a lower-latency model. This ticket captures the incident retro, triage decisions, and concrete follow-ups to harden future rollouts with automated safety checks and measurable rollback criteria.
timeline:
2026-02-09 09:12 UTC - Canary started (5%)
2026-02-09 09:18 UTC - First spike in median latency (+2.8x) for 95th percentile requests
2026-02-09 09:21 UTC - Error rate (invalid response format) increased from 0.02% -> 0.9%
2026-02-09 09:22 UTC - Automated watcher triggered and increased shadow sampling for v3.2.1
2026-02-09 09:23 UTC - Auto-fallback policy routed traffic away from v3.2.1 to v3.2.0
2026-02-09 09:40 UTC - Incident declared; Canary paused; Immediate mitigation applied: scale up pool for v3.2.0 and run ad-hoc validation suite
2026-02-10 15:00 UTC - Root cause hypothesis confirmed (kernel selection bug under long-seq conditions); fix queued in PR #2345
root_cause: A kernel-selection edge case in the runtime optimizer: for a subset of long-context requests (>2048 tokens) the runtime incorrectly selected an fp16 kernel variant that produced occasional NaN values in the KV cache and malformed logits leading to invalid response structures. The regression was introduced by a heuristics change in runtime-1.21.
immediate_actions: Paused canary rollout and routed remaining canary traffic to stable model
Disabled the 'aggressive-kernel-heuristic' flag for runtime pools serving v3.2.1
Opened hotfix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2345 (runtime kernel selector revert)
Created an incident channel (#inc-2026-02-09-model-rollout) and notified SRE/Eng/PM
follow_up_tasks: Add pre-rollout synthetic long-sequence test to CI that exercises kernel heuristics (owner: Arjun Patel) - ENG-15412
Add a canary safety gate that verifies no increase >0.5% in invalid-response-rate over 30m (owner: SRE) - ENG-15420
Implement shadow-traffic validation pipeline that runs structured-output checks against production traffic (owner: Maya Chen) - ENG-15445
Automate rollback decision: codify metrics thresholds (latency p95, invalid-response-rate, token-drop-rate) and implement hysteresis to prevent flapping (owner: Diego Morales) - ENG-15477
Improve telemetry: add KV-cache NaN counter and kernel-variant histograms to per-model dashboards (owner: Observability team) - ENG-15485
Update runbook run steps and include checklist for canary pause/resume and emergency scale-up (owner: On-call lead) - ENG-15430
acceptance_criteria: Pre-rollout long-sequence test added and green in CI for all model releases
Canary safety gate implemented and documented; gate prevents canary promotion if any metric breaches defined thresholds
Shadow validation pipeline deployed to staging and verifies structured-output constraints on 5k samples per hour
Runbook updated with precise rollback commands, alert runbooks, and post-action templates
Dashboard panels show kernel-variant distribution and KV-cache NaN counter; alerts configured for >0 NaNs
decisions: Delay promotion of v3.2.1 until kernel-selector fix is validated by CI and canary safety gate
Require a minimum 2-hour warm-up canary window for models that change compilation heuristic flags
Default canary size remains 5% but increase to 10% for releases with compilation/runtime code changes after additional safety gates are in place
runbook_updates: Add step to toggle 'aggressive-kernel-heuristic' on a per-pool basis and validate behavior via telemetry
Add explicit validation: structured-output schema checks (JSON parseable, token counts, presence of end-of-sequence)
Include emergency rollback CLI snippets (redwoodctl rollout abort --model <model> --reason <ticket>)
Document steps to temporarily expand stable pool capacity and execute traffic reroute
monitoring_changes: New alert: invalid-response-rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m on any canary pool
Add kernel-variant histogram to per-model metrics with 1m resolution
Create SLO for canary-induced customer latency regressions with dedicated alerting
rollback_policy_changes: Introduce hysteresis: require breach for 10m and confirmation from two independent metrics before auto-rollback
Add manual-confirmation override for P0 rollbacks when customer-facing errors are low but internal signals exceed thresholds
Record rollback reason metadata and include runtime git sha to facilitate reproducibility
comments: 2026-02-09 | Maya Chen: Initial incident triage — suspect kernel selector. Hotfix PR opened.
2026-02-10 | Diego Morales: Observability added KV-cache NaN metrics to staging; alerts tested.
2026-02-11 | Arjun Patel: CI long-sequence test added; failing test surface reproduced locally.
2026-02-15 | Product: PM reviewed impact report; requested customer-facing communication template.
notes: This ticket consolidates both engineering and SRE follow-ups for the rollout incident. Priorities are: prevent silent corruption (NaNs), codify safety gates for all runtime heuristics, and provide clear automated rollback logic that balances availability and data integrity. The proposed follow-ups are scoped to incremental stories and should be tracked individually.
